{{Quote|We heard them first, talking quietly but carelessly, the way soldiers do when they think the danger's past and their officers are being hard cases. They were sitting in two of my old dining-room chairs. Stormtrooper armor, buckets off, blasters propped against the window out of reach. Varsh shot one and I shot the other. They didn't even have time to yell&mdash;just crumpled to the floor and lay staring at the ceiling. My ceiling.|An extract from ''The Year of Rage: A Citizen's History of the Coruscant Wars''|<ref name="Cut12">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-12-tales-of-the-new-republic|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 12: Tales of the New Republic}}</ref>}}
'''''The Year of Rage: A Citizen's History of the Coruscant Wars''''' was an autobiographical work that was written by [[Kinalos]], a soldier who had been present on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Imperial Civil War]], depicting his experiences during the conflict.
